--[[
	ShortcutPanel  -  Part-Icles V5 ShortcutKey System
	Copyright (C) 2026 Qwinkle

	Modal panel scaffolding for the Shortcuts UI. A separate panel (not a tab in
	Settings) opened by the "Shortcuts" button in Settings. Modal-ish: overlays
	Properties; closeable.

	Layout (configurable leader; chord shows as "<LEADER> + key" or bare chord when
	leader is (none)):
	  [ShortcutPanel  -  modal]
	  Desc: bind a chord, hold the leader to fire.
	  Leader: P            [Set] [(none)]    (leader-row; configurable)
	  [Search shortcuts...]                   (text filter)
	  [Reset all]               [Close]       (header buttons)
	  ─────────────────────────────────────
	  ▼ UI
	    Toggle UI           (unbound)        [Bind] [X]
	    Toggle Inventory    P + I            [Bind] [X]   (after user binds it)
	    ...
	  ▼ Tools / Edit / Animate / Emit / Editor (collapsible per ActionCatalog category)

	Build returns refs map: {panel, scrollList, searchBox, resetBtn, headerCloseBtn,
	leaderLabel, leaderSetBtn, leaderClearBtn}.
	Capture-state UX, conflict warning, and save flow are wired by
	`Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau` and the runtime in `Modules/Shortcuts/init.luau`.

	`implemented = true` filter applied at populate time so stub Action entries
	(ResetSelection, OpenGraphEditor, OpenColorPicker) don't appear in the bind list  - 
	users only see bindable actions.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local PanelSizes = require(script.Parent.PanelSizes)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local ShortcutPanel = {}

local DESCRIPTION = 'Bind a chord. Hold the leader (below) then tap the chord. Don\'t press the leader during capture.'

local function buildClassic(sg)
	-- 300x420  -  wider than RandomizerPanel because each row needs combo display + 2
	-- buttons. With nameBlob 130 + comboBlob -208 reserve + buttons 78 right gutter,
	-- 300 leaves ~120px for the combo display, enough for "P + Shift+X".
	local panel = W.makeToolPanel(sg, "Shortcuts", 300, 420)
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	panel.Visible = false

	local refs = {panel = panel}

	-- Built-in header close from W.makeToolPanel; expose for wiring layer.
	local hd = panel:FindFirstChild("Hd")
	if hd then refs.headerCloseBtn = hd:FindFirstChild("Close") end

	-- Brief description. Leader-row below carries the rest of the context.
	local descBlob = W.makeBlob("PGuardDesc", panel, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22))
	descBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 26)
	W.addPadding(descBlob, 6, 6, 4, 4)
	local desc = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	desc.Name = "DescText"
	desc.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	desc.Text = DESCRIPTION
	desc.TextWrapped = false
	desc.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	desc.Font = T.Font
	desc.TextSize = 9
	desc.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	desc.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	desc.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	desc.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	desc.Parent = descBlob

	-- Leader-row. "Leader: <KEY>  [Set] [(none)]". Capture flow + label refresh
	-- live in Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau via the refs exposed here.
	local leaderRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	leaderRow.Name = "LeaderRow"
	leaderRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leaderRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 52)
	leaderRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22)
	leaderRow.Parent = panel

	local leaderBlob = W.makeBlob("LeaderBlob", leaderRow, UDim2.new(1, -132, 1, 0))
	leaderBlob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	W.addPadding(leaderBlob, 6, 4, 0, 0)
	local leaderLabel = W.makeLabel("L", leaderBlob, "Leader: P", T.BrightGold, T.Font, 10)
	leaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	leaderLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	refs.leaderLabel = leaderLabel

	local leaderSetBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderSet", leaderRow, "Set", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderSetBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderSetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 2)
	leaderSetBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderSetBtn = leaderSetBtn

	local leaderClearBtn = W.makeButton("LeaderClear", leaderRow, "(none)", UDim2.new(0, 56, 1, -4), T.DarkGold)
	leaderClearBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderClearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 2)
	leaderClearBtn.TextSize = 10
	refs.leaderClearBtn = leaderClearBtn

	-- Search box (text filter). Filter logic lives in Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau.
	local searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
	searchBox.Name = "ShortcutsSearch"
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search shortcuts..."
	searchBox.Text = ""
	searchBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	searchBox.Font = T.Font
	searchBox.TextSize = 9
	searchBox.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	searchBox.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	searchBox.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	searchBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
	searchBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 78)
	searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18)
	searchBox.Parent = panel
	W.addCorner(searchBox, UDim.new(0, 3))
	W.addPadding(searchBox, 0, 0, 4, 4)
	refs.searchBox = searchBox

	-- Reset-all button. Two-click confirm flow wired by Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring.luau.
	local resetBtn = W.makeButton("ShortcutsReset", panel, "Reset all", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18), T.DarkGold)
	resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 100)
	resetBtn.TextSize = 9
	refs.resetBtn = resetBtn

	-- Scrollable action list. Populated by Wiring from ctx.Actions filtered by
	-- `def.implemented == true`.
	local scrollList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollList.Name = "ShortcutsList"
	scrollList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scrollList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 122)
	scrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -128)
	scrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollList.ScrollBarThickness = 1
	scrollList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scrollList.Parent = panel
	W.addListLayout(scrollList, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	refs.scrollList = scrollList

	-- Placeholder shown only until Wiring.populate replaces with per-category rows.
	local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
	placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
	placeholder.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
	placeholder.Font = T.Font
	placeholder.TextSize = 8
	placeholder.TextWrapped = true
	placeholder.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	placeholder.Parent = scrollList

	return refs
end

-- Width of the Set and (none) buttons in the leader row.
local LEADER_BUTTON = 64
-- Two lines of caption text.
local DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT = 32

-- The same refs on the mode's tool shell. Modules/Shortcuts/Wiring fills the list and drives
-- the leader row, the search and the two-click "Reset all".
local function buildModern(sg)
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local panel, chrome = W.makeToolShell(sg, "Shortcuts", sizes.Shortcuts, sizes.ShortcutsHeight)
	panel:SetAttribute("_opaquePanel", true)
	panel:SetAttribute("_noSnap", true)
	local body = chrome.body
	local gap = LAYOUT.RowGap
	local refs = { panel = panel, headerCloseBtn = chrome.close }

	local description = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	description.Name = "DescText"
	description.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	description.Text = DESCRIPTION
	description.TextWrapped = true
	description.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	description.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	description.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	description.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT)
	TypeScale.style(description, "Caption")
	W.paint(description, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	description.Parent = body
	local top = DESCRIPTION_HEIGHT + gap

	-- "Leader: <key>" with Set and (none) at the right.
	local leaderRow = W.makeRowFrame(body, "LeaderRow", 0)
	leaderRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	local leaderLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	leaderLabel.Name = "L"
	leaderLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leaderLabel.Text = "Leader: P"
	leaderLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	leaderLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	leaderLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LEADER_BUTTON + gap) * 2, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(leaderLabel, "Label")
	W.paint(leaderLabel, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	leaderLabel.Parent = leaderRow
	refs.leaderLabel = leaderLabel

	local leaderSet = W.makeActionButton(leaderRow, "LeaderSet", "Set", 0, "TextSecondary")
	leaderSet.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderSet.Size = UDim2.new(0, LEADER_BUTTON, 1, 0)
	leaderSet.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(LEADER_BUTTON + gap), 0, 0)
	refs.leaderSetBtn = leaderSet

	local leaderClear = W.makeActionButton(leaderRow, "LeaderClear", "(none)", 0, "TextSecondary")
	leaderClear.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	leaderClear.Size = UDim2.new(0, LEADER_BUTTON, 1, 0)
	leaderClear.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.leaderClearBtn = leaderClear
	top += LAYOUT.Row + gap

	local searchBox, searchField = W.makeSearchField(body, "ShortcutsSearch", "Search shortcuts...")
	searchField.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	refs.searchBox = searchBox
	top += LAYOUT.Search + gap

	local reset = W.makeActionButton(body, "ShortcutsReset", "Reset all", 0, "TextSecondary")
	reset.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	refs.resetBtn = reset
	top += LAYOUT.Row + gap

	local scrollList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scrollList.Name = "ShortcutsList"
	scrollList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scrollList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top)
	scrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -top)
	scrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scrollList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scrollList.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	scrollList.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	scrollList.Parent = body
	W.addListLayout(scrollList, 4, Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, scrollList)
	refs.scrollList = scrollList

	-- Shown until Wiring.populate replaces it with the action rows.
	local placeholder = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	placeholder.Name = "Placeholder"
	placeholder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	placeholder.Text = "Loading…"
	placeholder.TextWrapped = true
	placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)
	TypeScale.style(placeholder, "Caption")
	W.paint(placeholder, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	placeholder.Parent = scrollList

	return refs
end

function ShortcutPanel.build(sg)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return buildClassic(sg)
	end
	return buildModern(sg)
end

return ShortcutPanel

--[[
	ThemeApply  -  live theme changes: UpdateTheme, SnapshotTheme, RestoreTheme.
	Loaded by UIBuilder/init.luau; receives UIBuilder and the Widgets table and adds the three
	methods to UIBuilder.
	UpdateTheme takes the saved theme values (nil = unchanged), recomputes every derived colour
	through Constants.refresh(), then repaints in two steps. First a walk moves text and frames
	that no registry knows, told only by their carrying an old role colour, onto the new one.
	Then the registered instances are painted from their roles. The order matters: the walk
	goes by colour alone, and a new panel colour can equal an old text colour (a dark theme's
	text against a light theme's panels), so whatever it made of a registered instance is put
	right by the repaint after it.
	Image tints are never matched by colour: an image shows a texture, a thumbnail or a picker
	surface. An icon that follows the theme registers its own repaint (W.paint, or a function
	in the repaints list).
	A mode or text-size change is not handled here: it changes sizes, so the UI is rebuilt.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

-- Roles the colour-matching walk follows, in priority order: when two roles share a colour
-- before a change, text carrying it follows the earlier role.
local TEXT_ROLES = { "TextPrimary", "TextHeading", "TextLabel", "TextSecondary", "TextDisabled", "Accent", "Success", "Warning", "Danger" }

-- Colours are stored at 8 bits; anything closer than half a step is the same colour.
local SAME_COLOR = 0.002

local function sameColor(first, second)
	return math.abs(first.R - second.R) < SAME_COLOR
		and math.abs(first.G - second.G) < SAME_COLOR
		and math.abs(first.B - second.B) < SAME_COLOR
end

-- Drops destroyed instances from a registry list. `key` names the instance field of table entries.
local function sweepDead(list, key)
	local kept = 1
	for index = 1, #list do
		local entry = list[index]
		local inst = key and entry[key] or entry
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			list[kept] = entry
			kept += 1
		end
	end
	for index = kept, #list do
		list[index] = nil
	end
end

-- { old, new } pairs for the text roles whose colour changed.
local function changedTextRoles(before)
	local remap = {}
	for _, role in ipairs(TEXT_ROLES) do
		local old = before[role]
		local claimed = false
		for _, pair in ipairs(remap) do
			if sameColor(pair.old, old) then
				claimed = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not claimed and not sameColor(old, T[role]) then
			table.insert(remap, { old = old, new = T[role] })
		end
	end
	return remap
end

local function remapColor(color, remap)
	for _, pair in ipairs(remap) do
		if sameColor(color, pair.old) then
			return pair.new
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Moves every text and accent-coloured frame from an old role colour to the new one.
-- Anything marked `_noColorRemap` is left alone: a user colour, a compositing layer, or white
-- text on a coloured fill. So is any frame under a UIGradient: its colour is the gradient's
-- base, never a theme colour.
local function remapDescendants(screenGui, remap)
	for _, desc in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:GetAttribute("_noColorRemap") then
			continue
		end
		if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox") then
			local text = remapColor(desc.TextColor3, remap)
			if text then
				desc.TextColor3 = text
			end
			if desc:IsA("TextBox") then
				local placeholder = remapColor(desc.PlaceholderColor3, remap)
				if placeholder then
					desc.PlaceholderColor3 = placeholder
				end
			end
		elseif desc:IsA("Frame") or desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			local fill = remapColor(desc.BackgroundColor3, remap)
			if fill and not desc:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
				desc.BackgroundColor3 = fill
			end
		end
	end
end

return function(UIBuilder, W)
	-- Repaints everything the registries track from the current T.
	local function repaintRegistered(themed)
		for _, stroke in ipairs(themed.strokes) do
			stroke.Color = T.Border
			stroke.Transparency = T.BorderAlpha
		end
		for _, panel in ipairs(themed.panels) do
			panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
			-- Modal dialogs stay solid whatever the theme's see-through.
			if not panel:GetAttribute("_opaquePanel") then
				panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
			end
		end
		for _, blob in ipairs(themed.blobs) do
			blob.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			blob.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
		end
		for _, fill in ipairs(themed.fills) do
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = T.SliderFill
		end
		for _, scrollbar in ipairs(themed.scrollbars) do
			scrollbar.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.roles) do
			entry.inst[entry.prop] = T[entry.role]
		end
		-- After strokes: a toggle's outline depends on its state.
		for _, toggle in ipairs(themed.toggles) do
			W.paintToggle(toggle)
		end

		-- Producer: WidgetAxis.trackAxis registers { btn, color, selBg }; `_selected` on the button
		-- (set by the axis-toggle handlers) picks the selected paint.
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.axisButtons) do
			local button = entry.btn
			if button.Parent then
				W.paintAxisButton(button, entry.color, entry.selBg, button:GetAttribute("_selected") == true)
			end
		end
		for _, entry in ipairs(themed.axisColored) do
			if entry.inst and entry.inst.Parent then
				local color = T["Axis" .. (entry.axis or "X")]
				if color then
					entry.inst[entry.prop] = color
				end
			end
		end
		for _, dot in ipairs(themed.evenDots) do
			dot.BackgroundColor3 = dot:GetAttribute("_even") and T.BrightGold or T.DarkGold
		end
		for _, image in ipairs(themed.panelImages) do
			image.Image = T.BgImage or ""
			image.ImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency or 1
		end
		-- Widgets that paint from T themselves (deck tabs, tray chips, the workspace bar).
		for _, repaint in ipairs(themed.repaints) do
			pcall(repaint)
		end
	end

	-- panelAlpha and blobAlpha are saved with the theme and drawn by the Classic mode only.
	-- Argument 10 (font scale) is accepted and ignored: text sizes come from the theme's text size.
	function UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(accent, background, slider, panelAlpha, blobAlpha, fontName, textAccent, blobColor, scrollBarColor, _fontScale, bgImage, bgImageTransparency)
		local themed = W.getThemed()
		for _, name in ipairs({ "strokes", "panels", "blobs", "fills", "scrollbars", "toggles", "panelImages", "evenDots" }) do
			sweepDead(themed[name])
		end
		sweepDead(themed.roles, "inst")

		local before = {}
		for _, role in ipairs(TEXT_ROLES) do
			before[role] = T[role]
		end

		if accent then
			T.InputAccent = accent
		end
		if background then
			T.InputBg = background
		end
		if slider then
			T.InputSlider = slider
		end
		if blobColor then
			T.InputBlob = blobColor
		end
		if scrollBarColor then
			T.InputScrollBar = scrollBarColor
		end
		if textAccent then
			T.TextAccent = textAccent
		end
		if panelAlpha ~= nil then
			T.InputPanelAlpha = panelAlpha
		end
		if blobAlpha ~= nil then
			T.InputBlobAlpha = blobAlpha
		end
		if bgImage ~= nil then
			T.BgImage = bgImage
		end
		if bgImageTransparency ~= nil then
			T.BgImageTransparency = bgImageTransparency
		end

		local fontChanged = false
		if fontName and fontName ~= T.Font.Name then
			local ok, font = pcall(function()
				return Enum.Font[fontName]
			end)
			if ok and font then
				T.Font = font
				fontChanged = true
			end
		end

		C.refresh()

		-- Before the registered repaint, never after it: see the header.
		local screenGui = self._screenGui
		if screenGui then
			local remap = changedTextRoles(before)
			if #remap > 0 then
				remapDescendants(screenGui, remap)
			end
		end
		repaintRegistered(themed)
		if fontChanged and screenGui then
			TypeScale.reapply(screenGui)
		end
	end

	function UIBuilder:SnapshotTheme()
		return {
			Accent = T.InputAccent,
			Background = T.InputBg,
			Slider = T.InputSlider,
			Blob = T.InputBlob,
			ScrollBar = T.InputScrollBar,
			TextAccent = T.TextAccent,
			PanelAlpha = T.InputPanelAlpha,
			BlobAlpha = T.InputBlobAlpha,
			Font = T.Font,
			BgImage = T.BgImage,
			BgImageTransparency = T.BgImageTransparency,
		}
	end

	function UIBuilder:RestoreTheme(snapshot)
		self:UpdateTheme(snapshot.Accent, snapshot.Background, snapshot.Slider, snapshot.PanelAlpha, snapshot.BlobAlpha, snapshot.Font.Name,
			snapshot.TextAccent, snapshot.Blob, snapshot.ScrollBar, nil, snapshot.BgImage or "", snapshot.BgImageTransparency or 1)
	end
end

--[[
	ThemeModes  -  the selectable looks of the plugin UI: Typo, Slate, Shannon and Classic.
	API:
	  ThemeModes.ORDER, ThemeModes.DEFAULT, ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES, ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
	  ThemeModes.get(id)             mode table; an unknown id falls back to the default mode.
	  ThemeModes.textSize(value)     a supported text size; anything else falls back to the default.
	  ThemeModes.resolve(inputs, id, textSize)   { Id, Structure, Metrics, Surface, Roles }
	Inputs are the saved theme colours: { panel, field, accent, text, slider, scrollBar }.
	Roles are derived on every call and never saved, so the theme format stays the same.
	Consumer: UIBuilder/Constants fills T and LAYOUT from the result.
]]

local ColorMath = require(script.ColorMath)

local ThemeModes = {}

local MODES = {
	Typo = require(script.Typo),
	Slate = require(script.Slate),
	Shannon = require(script.Shannon),
	Classic = require(script.Classic),
}

ThemeModes.ColorMath = ColorMath
ThemeModes.ORDER = { "Typo", "Slate", "Shannon", "Classic" }
ThemeModes.DEFAULT = "Typo"
-- Only multiples of 4 draw on whole pixels at the 125% default UI scale.
ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES = { 12, 16 }
ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE = 16

-- Status hues with the saturation each is solved at.
local STATUS = {
	Success = { color = Color3.fromRGB(139, 195, 74), saturation = 0.62 },
	Warning = { color = Color3.fromRGB(224, 160, 64), saturation = 0.70 },
	Danger = { color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 100, 100), saturation = 0.58 },
}
local STATUS_FLOOR = 4.6
local FILL_FLOOR = 3.1

function ThemeModes.get(id)
	return MODES[id] or MODES[ThemeModes.DEFAULT]
end

function ThemeModes.textSize(value)
	for _, size in ipairs(ThemeModes.TEXT_SIZES) do
		if size == value then
			return size
		end
	end
	return ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
end

-- A saved fill colour is kept when it stands out from `background`, otherwise it is re-solved.
local function resolveFill(saved, background, light)
	if ColorMath.contrast(saved, background) >= FILL_FLOOR then
		return saved
	end
	local hue, saturation = saved:ToHSV()
	return ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation, { background }, FILL_FLOOR, light)
end

-- Roles the modes share unless a mode sets its own: status colours and the slider / scrollbar fills.
local function addSharedRoles(roles, inputs)
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(roles.Panel)
	local surfaces = { roles.Panel, roles.Field, roles.Header }
	for name, status in pairs(STATUS) do
		if roles[name] == nil then
			local hue = status.color:ToHSV()
			roles[name] = ColorMath.solveTone(hue, status.saturation, surfaces, STATUS_FLOOR, light)
		end
	end
	if roles.SliderFill == nil then
		roles.SliderFill = resolveFill(inputs.slider, roles.Field, light)
	end
	if roles.ScrollBar == nil then
		roles.ScrollBar = resolveFill(inputs.scrollBar, roles.Panel, light)
	end
end

function ThemeModes.resolve(inputs, id, textSize)
	local mode = ThemeModes.get(id)
	local roles = mode.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	addSharedRoles(roles, inputs)
	return {
		Id = mode.Id,
		Structure = mode.Structure,
		Metrics = mode.Metrics[ThemeModes.textSize(textSize)],
		Surface = mode.Surface,
		Roles = roles,
	}
end

return ThemeModes

--[[
	Classic  -  theme mode that keeps the plugin's original look: see-through panels, a filled box
	behind every label and header, the theme font for all text at its original sizes, and text
	shades taken straight from the theme's text colour.
	Returns { Id, Structure, Metrics, Surface, derive }. Nothing here is solved for contrast:
	the saved colours are used as they are. Structure.Classic tells widgets to build the
	original shapes; the text-size option does not apply.
]]

local Classic = {}

--[[
	ColorMath  -  contrast and colour-space helpers for theme derivation. Pure; no requires.
	API: quantize, luminance, contrast, minContrast, mix, isLight, toOklch, fromOklch,
	oklchWithContrast, solveTone, backOff.
	Contrast is the WCAG ratio (1 to 21). OKLCH keeps hue steady while lightness changes.
]]

local ColorMath = {}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- A panel brighter than this counts as a light theme.
local LIGHT_THEME_LUMINANCE = 0.18

local function channelToLinear(channel)
	if channel <= 0.04045 then
		return channel / 12.92
	end
	return ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4
end

local function linearToChannel(value)
	value = math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
	if value <= 0.0031308 then
		return 12.92 * value
	end
	return 1.055 * value ^ (1 / 2.4) - 0.055
end

-- Round each channel to 8 bits, the precision a saved theme keeps.
function ColorMath.quantize(color)
	local red = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	local green = math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	local blue = math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
	return Color3.fromRGB(red, green, blue)
end

-- WCAG relative luminance, 0 to 1.
function ColorMath.luminance(color)
	return 0.2126 * channelToLinear(color.R) + 0.7152 * channelToLinear(color.G) + 0.0722 * channelToLinear(color.B)
end

-- WCAG contrast ratio between two colours.
function ColorMath.contrast(first, second)
	local firstLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(first)
	local secondLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(second)
	local brighter = math.max(firstLuminance, secondLuminance)
	local darker = math.min(firstLuminance, secondLuminance)
	return (brighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)
end

-- Lowest contrast of `color` against a list of backgrounds.
function ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds)
	local lowest = math.huge
	for _, background in ipairs(backgrounds) do
		lowest = math.min(lowest, ColorMath.contrast(color, background))
	end
	return lowest
end

-- sRGB blend of `from` toward `to`, rounded to 8 bits.
function ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount)
	return ColorMath.quantize(from:Lerp(to, amount))
end

function ColorMath.isLight(color)
	return ColorMath.luminance(color) > LIGHT_THEME_LUMINANCE
end

-- Returns lightness (0 to 1), chroma and hue (degrees).
function ColorMath.toOklch(color)
	local red = channelToLinear(color.R)
	local green = channelToLinear(color.G)
	local blue = channelToLinear(color.B)

	local long = (0.4122214708 * red + 0.5363325363 * green + 0.0514459929 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)
	local medium = (0.2119034982 * red + 0.6806995451 * green + 0.1073969566 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)
	local short = (0.0883024619 * red + 0.2817188376 * green + 0.6299787005 * blue) ^ (1 / 3)

	local lightness = 0.2104542553 * long + 0.7936177850 * medium - 0.0040720468 * short
	local greenRed = 1.9779984951 * long - 2.4285922050 * medium + 0.4505937099 * short
	local blueYellow = 0.0259040371 * long + 0.7827717662 * medium - 0.8086757660 * short

	local chroma = math.sqrt(greenRed * greenRed + blueYellow * blueYellow)
	local hue = math.deg(math.atan2(blueYellow, greenRed)) % 360
	return lightness, chroma, hue
end

-- Linear sRGB channels for an OKLCH colour; values outside 0..1 are out of gamut.
local function oklchToLinear(lightness, chroma, hue)
	local greenRed = chroma * math.cos(math.rad(hue))
	local blueYellow = chroma * math.sin(math.rad(hue))

	local long = (lightness + 0.3963377774 * greenRed + 0.2158037573 * blueYellow) ^ 3
	local medium = (lightness - 0.1055613458 * greenRed - 0.0638541728 * blueYellow) ^ 3
	local short = (lightness - 0.0894841775 * greenRed - 1.2914855480 * blueYellow) ^ 3

	local red = 4.0767416621 * long - 3.3077115913 * medium + 0.2309699292 * short
	local green = -1.2684380046 * long + 2.6097574011 * medium - 0.3413193965 * short
	local blue = -0.0041960863 * long - 0.7034186147 * medium + 1.7076147010 * short
	return red, green, blue
end

local function inGamut(value)
	return value >= -0.0001 and value <= 1.0001
end

-- OKLCH to an 8-bit colour. Out-of-gamut colours lose chroma until they fit.
function ColorMath.fromOklch(lightness, chroma, hue)
	local reduced = chroma
	for _ = 1, 60 do
		local red, green, blue = oklchToLinear(lightness, reduced, hue)
		if inGamut(red) and inGamut(green) and inGamut(blue) then
			return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.new(linearToChannel(red), linearToChannel(green), linearToChannel(blue)))
		end
		reduced *= 0.95
	end
	local red, green, blue = oklchToLinear(lightness, 0, hue)
	return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.new(linearToChannel(red), linearToChannel(green), linearToChannel(blue)))
end

-- OKLCH colour whose lightness moves away from the backgrounds until `floor` contrast holds.
function ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, chroma, hue, backgrounds, floor, light)
	local step = light and -0.02 or 0.02
	local current = lightness
	local color = ColorMath.fromOklch(current, chroma, hue)
	while ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds) < floor and current > 0.02 and current < 0.98 do
		current += step
		color = ColorMath.fromOklch(current, chroma, hue)
	end
	-- A mid-tone background can be out of reach for a tinted colour; plain black or white is the most it allows.
	if ColorMath.minContrast(color, backgrounds) < floor then
		return light and BLACK or WHITE
	end
	return color
end

-- True when `color` sits on the far side of every background and reaches `target` against each.
local function reaches(color, backgrounds, target, light)
	local colorLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(color)
	for _, background in ipairs(backgrounds) do
		local backgroundLuminance = ColorMath.luminance(background)
		if light and colorLuminance >= backgroundLuminance then
			return false
		end
		if not light and colorLuminance <= backgroundLuminance then
			return false
		end
		if ColorMath.contrast(color, background) < target then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function fromHsv(hue, saturation, value)
	return ColorMath.quantize(Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, value))
end

-- The least extreme HSV value that reaches `target` against every background at the given
-- hue. Saturation drops in steps of 0.05 when full value (or zero, for light themes) misses.
function ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation, backgrounds, target, light)
	local current = saturation
	while current >= -0.001 do
		local used = math.max(0, current)
		local extreme = light and 0 or 1
		if reaches(fromHsv(hue, used, extreme), backgrounds, target, light) then
			-- Bisection: 30 halvings resolve value far below 1/255.
			local low = 0
			local high = 1
			for _ = 1, 30 do
				local middle = (low + high) / 2
				local passes = reaches(fromHsv(hue, used, middle), backgrounds, target, light)
				if passes == light then
					low = middle
				else
					high = middle
				end
			end
			if light then
				return fromHsv(hue, used, low)
			end
			local value = high
			local color = fromHsv(hue, used, value)
			-- 8-bit rounding can land just under the target; step up until it holds.
			while not reaches(color, backgrounds, target, light) and value < 1 do
				value = math.min(1, value + 0.004)
				color = fromHsv(hue, used, value)
			end
			return color
		end
		current -= 0.05
	end
	return light and BLACK or WHITE
end

-- `from` pulled toward `to` by `pull`, easing back in steps of 0.01 until `floor` holds.
function ColorMath.backOff(from, to, pull, floor, backgrounds)
	local amount = pull
	while amount > 0 and ColorMath.minContrast(ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount), backgrounds) < floor do
		amount = math.floor((amount - 0.01) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	end
	return ColorMath.mix(from, to, amount)
end

return ColorMath

	local hover = ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, light and 0.02 or 0.18)
	local pressed = ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, light and 0.04 or 0.47)

		ToggleOn = accent,
		ToggleOff = light and ColorMath.mix(canvas, BLACK, 0.07) or pressed,
		KnobOn = knobOn,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Shannon

	Disabled = 3.2,
	Control = 3.1,
	Accent = 3.1,
	Subtle = 1.6,
}

local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

-- A saved field colour is kept only when it stands apart from the panel on the readable side.
local function resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local field = inputs.field
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local wrongSide = (not light) and ColorMath.luminance(field) < ColorMath.luminance(panel)
	if ColorMath.contrast(field, panel) >= 1.2 and not wrongSide then
		return field
	end
	local hue, saturation = panel:ToHSV()
	return ColorMath.solveTone(hue, saturation * 0.9, { panel }, 1.25, light)
end

-- Heading hue comes from the text colour when it has colour, otherwise from the accent.
local function resolveHeading(inputs, surfaces, light, ColorMath)
	local _, textChroma = ColorMath.toOklch(inputs.text)
	local source = textChroma >= 0.04 and inputs.text or inputs.accent
	local _, chroma, hue = ColorMath.toOklch(source)
	local lightness = light and 0.45 or 0.80
	return ColorMath.oklchWithContrast(lightness, math.min(chroma, 0.12), hue, surfaces, FLOOR.Heading, light)
end

function Typo.derive(inputs, ColorMath)
	local panel = inputs.panel
	local light = ColorMath.isLight(panel)
	local field = resolveField(inputs, light, ColorMath)
	local header = ColorMath.mix(panel, field, 0.5)
	local surfaces = { panel, field, header }

	local textHue, textSaturation = inputs.text:ToHSV()
	local accentHue, accentSaturation = inputs.accent:ToHSV()

	local primary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.25, surfaces, FLOOR.Primary, light)
	local secondary = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.55, surfaces, FLOOR.Secondary, light)
	local disabled = ColorMath.solveTone(textHue, textSaturation * 0.45, surfaces, FLOOR.Disabled, light)
	local label = ColorMath.backOff(primary, panel, 0.28, FLOOR.Label, { panel })
	local heading = resolveHeading(inputs, { panel, header }, light, ColorMath)

	local borderControl = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.6, 0.45), { panel, header }, FLOOR.Control, light)
	local borderSubtle = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, math.min(accentSaturation * 0.5, 0.35), { panel }, FLOOR.Subtle, light)

	local accent = inputs.accent
	if ColorMath.minContrast(accent, { panel, field }) < FLOOR.Accent then
		accent = ColorMath.solveTone(accentHue, accentSaturation, { panel, field }, FLOOR.Accent, light)
	end
	local onAccent = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, accent) < 4.5 then
		onAccent = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, accent) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, accent) and BLACK or WHITE
	end

	local knobOn = panel
	if ColorMath.contrast(panel, heading) < 3 then
		knobOn = ColorMath.contrast(BLACK, heading) > ColorMath.contrast(WHITE, heading) and BLACK or WHITE
	end
	-- The focus ring sits on the field, where the heading hue can be too close.
	local focus = heading
	if ColorMath.contrast(focus, field) < 3 then
		focus = primary
	end

	return {
		Panel = panel,
		Header = header,
		Band = panel,
		Field = field,
		FieldHover = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.08),
		Selected = ColorMath.mix(field, accent, 0.28),
		Sunken = ColorMath.mix(panel, BLACK, light and 0.08 or 0.35),
		TextPrimary = primary,
		TextHeading = heading,
		TextLabel = label,
		TextSecondary = secondary,
		TextDisabled = disabled,
		Outline = ColorMath.mix(field, primary, 0.12),
		OutlineHover = borderControl,
		Focus = focus,
		Divider = borderSubtle,
		Rule = borderSubtle,
		PanelStroke = borderSubtle,
		Accent = accent,
		OnAccent = onAccent,
		ToggleOn = heading,
		ToggleOff = field,
		KnobOn = knobOn,
		KnobOff = secondary,
	}
end

return Typo

--[[
	ThemeStore  -  the saved theme as text: the ThemeJSON plugin setting and the theme code box.
	  ThemeStore.decode(json)            the values present in a theme code, or nil if unreadable.
	  ThemeStore.encode()                the current theme in T as a theme code.
	  ThemeStore.load(json)              writes a saved theme into T and refreshes; used before Build.
	  ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)  "123" -> "rbxassetid://123".
	Colours are hex strings; panelAlpha and blobAlpha are percentages (the Classic mode's
	see-through). A fontSize from an older code is dropped, and a code without a mode gets the
	default mode.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local ThemeModes = require(script.Parent.ThemeModes)
local T = C.T

local ThemeStore = {}

-- Version written into new theme codes.
local FORMAT_VERSION = 3

local COLOR_KEYS = { "accent", "bg", "blob", "slider", "scrollBar", "textAccent" }

function ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(text)
	text = (text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if text == "" then
		return ""
	end
	if text:match("^%d+$") then
		return "rbxassetid://" .. text
	end
	return text
end

function ThemeStore.decode(json)
	if type(json) ~= "string" or json == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(json)
	end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local theme = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		if type(data[key]) == "string" then
			theme[key] = C.hexToColor3(data[key])
		end
	end
	if type(data.font) == "string" then
		theme.font = data.font
	end
	if type(data.bgImage) == "string" then
		theme.bgImage = ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(data.bgImage)
	end
	if type(data.bgImageAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.bgImageTransparency = math.clamp(data.bgImageAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.panelAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.panelAlpha = math.clamp(data.panelAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.blobAlpha) == "number" then
		theme.blobAlpha = math.clamp(data.blobAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(data.mode) == "string" then
		theme.mode = ThemeModes.get(data.mode).Id
	end
	if type(data.textSize) == "number" then
		theme.textSize = ThemeModes.textSize(data.textSize)
	end
	return theme
end

function ThemeStore.encode()
	return HttpService:JSONEncode({
		v = FORMAT_VERSION,
		mode = T.Mode,
		textSize = T.TextSize,
		accent = C.color3ToHex(T.InputAccent),
		bg = C.color3ToHex(T.InputBg),
		blob = C.color3ToHex(T.InputBlob),
		slider = C.color3ToHex(T.InputSlider),
		scrollBar = C.color3ToHex(T.InputScrollBar),
		textAccent = C.color3ToHex(T.TextAccent),
		panelAlpha = math.floor(T.InputPanelAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		blobAlpha = math.floor(T.InputBlobAlpha * 100 + 0.5),
		font = T.Font.Name,
		bgImage = T.BgImage or "",
		bgImageAlpha = math.floor((T.BgImageTransparency or 1) * 100 + 0.5),
	})
end

-- Mutates T (the shared theme table). Runs before Build, so nothing needs repainting.
function ThemeStore.load(json)
	local theme = ThemeStore.decode(json)
	if not theme then
		return false
	end
	T.InputAccent = theme.accent or T.InputAccent
	T.InputBg = theme.bg or T.InputBg
	T.InputBlob = theme.blob or T.InputBlob
	T.InputSlider = theme.slider or T.InputSlider
	T.InputScrollBar = theme.scrollBar or T.InputScrollBar
	T.TextAccent = theme.textAccent or T.TextAccent
	T.BgImage = theme.bgImage or T.BgImage
	T.BgImageTransparency = theme.bgImageTransparency or T.BgImageTransparency
	T.InputPanelAlpha = theme.panelAlpha or T.InputPanelAlpha
	T.InputBlobAlpha = theme.blobAlpha or T.InputBlobAlpha
	T.Mode = theme.mode or ThemeModes.DEFAULT
	T.TextSize = theme.textSize or ThemeModes.DEFAULT_TEXT_SIZE
	if theme.font then
		local ok, font = pcall(function()
			return Enum.Font[theme.font]
		end)
		if ok and font then
			T.Font = font
		end
	end
	C.refresh()
	return true
end

return ThemeStore

local DeckPages = {}

-- W.makeSlider's fixed height.
local SLIDER_HEIGHT = 28

-- Height of a deck whose page stacks `rows` rows plus `extra` pixels of other content.
local function deckHeight(rows, extra)
	local gaps = math.max(rows - 1, 0) * LAYOUT.RowGap
	return LAYOUT.TitleBar + LAYOUT.PanelPad * 2 + rows * LAYOUT.Row + gaps + extra
end

function DeckPages.deckLayout()
	local sizes = PanelSizes.get()
	local sliderBlock = SLIDER_HEIGHT + LAYOUT.RowGap
	return {
		ReWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		ReMinWidth = sizes.ReDeckMin,
		ToolsWidth = sizes.PropertyToolsDeck,
		ToolsMinWidth = sizes.ReDeck,
		Size = deckHeight(3, sliderBlock),
		Time = deckHeight(2, sliderBlock),
		Clipboard = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
		Shifter = sizes.PropertyToolsHeight,
	}
end

-- A multiplier slider and the page's switches under it, with Apply / Reset held at the page's
-- bottom edge: a panel dragged shorter than its rows gives up the switches and keeps the buttons.
local function buildScalePage(page, switches)
	local rows = Instance.new("Frame")
	rows.Name = "Rows"
	rows.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rows.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(LAYOUT.Row + LAYOUT.RowGap))
	rows.ClipsDescendants = true
	rows.Parent = page
	W.addListLayout(rows, LAYOUT.RowGap)

	local slider, input, setValue, getValue = W.makeSlider(rows, 0.5, 2, 1, nil, "%.2fx", true)
	slider.LayoutOrder = 0

	local toggles = {}
	for index, switch in ipairs(switches) do
		toggles[index] = W.makeSwitchRow(rows, switch.name, switch.label, index)
	end

	local buttons, buttonRow = W.makeButtonRow(page, "Buttons", {
		{ name = "Ap", text = "Apply" },
		{ name = "Rs", text = "Reset", role = "TextSecondary" },
	}, 0)

	buttonRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)

	return {
		slider = slider, input = input, setValue = setValue, getValue = getValue,
		toggles = toggles, apply = buttons[1], reset = buttons[2],
	}
end

	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- Word-boundary match: start of label or after space/underscore. Query escaped against
-- Luau pattern specials so chars like `(`, `.`, `%`, `[`, `*` match literally.
local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
local function _labelMatches(label, q)
	local esc = _escapePattern(q)
	return label:sub(1, #q) == q or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
end

-- Wire search filtering on a scroll frame (call after building toggles).
-- External code (selection-filter, type-toggles) calls
-- `ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)` when it changes visibility while
-- a search is active. The next clear-search re-snapshots from post-filter state
-- instead of restoring stale pre-filter visibility (which would undo the filter).
function ToolPanels.invalidateSearchSnapshot(searchBox)
	if searchBox then searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", true) end
end

function ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scrollFrame)
	if not searchBox or not scrollFrame then return end
	local _saved = {} -- {[frame] = wasVisible} snapshot before search (bodies + rows)
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local query = searchBox.Text:lower()
		local isSearch = query ~= ""
		-- If external code (filter toggle) marked the snapshot dirty, drop it and
		-- re-snapshot from current state. Otherwise clearing search would restore
		-- stale pre-filter visibility and undo the filter's just-applied changes.
		if searchBox:GetAttribute("_savedDirty") then
			_saved = {}
			searchBox:SetAttribute("_savedDirty", nil)
		end
		-- Save state on first search (bodies + rows from selection filter)
		if isSearch and next(_saved) == nil then
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Body" or d:GetAttribute("PropRow") or d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then _saved[d] = d.Visible end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then _saved[s] = s.Visible end end
		end
		if isSearch then
			local hits = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and d:GetAttribute("PropRow") then
					local lbl = d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
					if lbl then
						local match = _saved[d] and _labelMatches(lbl.Text:lower(), query)
						d.Visible = match or false
						if match then local c = d.Parent; while c and c ~= scrollFrame do hits[c] = true; c = c.Parent end end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name:match("Section$") or d.Name:match("Sub$")) then d.Visible = hits[d] or false
				elseif d.Name == "Body" and d:IsA("Frame") then d.Visible = hits[d] or false end
			end
			for _, s in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetChildren()) do if s:IsA("Frame") then s.Visible = hits[s] or false end end
		else
			for d, vis in pairs(_saved) do d.Visible = vis end; _saved = {}
		end
		-- Sync arrows
		for _, d in ipairs(scrollFrame:GetDescendants()) do
			local hdr = d:IsA("Frame") and d:FindFirstChild("Header")
			if hdr then local ar = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow"); if ar then
				local body = d:FindFirstChild("Body"); if body then ar.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
			end end
		end
	end)
end

local function _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, peSections, excludeProps, keepFn)

-- Fills the Clipboard list with the union of every type's categories plus PE, and wires its search.
function ToolPanels.fillClipboardList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMap = propTypeMap
	W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
end

-- Fills the Shifter list: props whose TypeData type is shiftable (SHIFTABLE_TYPES) plus the
-- item-level emit timing attrs; PE rows come from the curated PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER list.
function ToolPanels.fillShifterList(scroll, searchBox, TypeRegistry)
	local function shiftable(typeName, prop)
		if typeName == "PE" or SHIFTABLE_ITEM_ATTRS[prop] then return true end
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
		local def = typeDef and typeDef.properties and typeDef.properties[prop]
		return def ~= nil and SHIFTABLE_TYPES[def.type] == true
	end
	local merged, propTypeMap = _mergeClipboards(TypeRegistry, PE_SECTIONS_SHIFTER, nil, shiftable)
	ToolPanels.propTypeMapShifter = propTypeMap
	W.buildPropToggles(scroll, merged, "Properties", 0, DISPLAY_NAMES)
	ToolPanels.wireSearch(searchBox, scroll)
end

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HANDLE_H = 8

-- The handle lands exactly on the neutral value within this many screen pixels of it.
local SNAP_PIXELS = 5

-- Builds a vertical slider with a gradient background.
-- xScale: 0-1 horizontal position (Scale-based for responsive layout).
-- trackHeightTrim / trackTop: how much shorter than `parent` the track is, and where it starts.
-- step: values are whole multiples of it, so the readout and the applied value are the same.
-- Returns getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout(box, scale, suffix): the box then shows the value
-- times `scale` (a whole number, with `suffix`) and sets the slider from what is typed into it.
local function makeVSlider(parent, xScale, gradient, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, step)
	local track = Instance.new("Frame"); track.Name = "Track"; track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 1, -trackHeightTrim); track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	track.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, trackTop)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); track.Parent = parent
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner"); cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4); cr.Parent = track
	local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient"); gr.Rotation = 90; gr.Parent = track
	gr.Color = gradient
	local handle = Instance.new("Frame"); handle.Name = "Handle"; handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); handle.Size = UDim2.new(1,4,0,HANDLE_H)
	handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5); handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
	-- White whatever the theme: a theme change must not repaint it as text-coloured.
	handle:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
	handle.ZIndex = 3; handle.Parent = track
	local hc = Instance.new("UICorner"); hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,3); hc.Parent = handle
	local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke"); hs.Color = Color3.new(0,0,0); hs.Thickness = 1; hs.Parent = handle

	local current = defaultVal
	local dragging = false
	local showValue = nil
	local lowest, highest = math.min(minVal, maxVal), math.max(minVal, maxVal)

	local function setVal(value)
		current = math.clamp(math.round(value / step) * step, lowest, highest)
		handle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, (current - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0)
		if showValue then
			showValue()
		end
	end
	local function getVal()
		return current
	end

	-- Sets the value from a screen height on the track.
	local function setFromMouse(mouseY)
		local height = track.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local share = math.clamp((mouseY - track.AbsolutePosition.Y) / height, 0, 1)
		local neutral = (defaultVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
		if math.abs(share - neutral) * height <= SNAP_PIXELS then
			share = neutral
		end
		setVal(minVal + share * (maxVal - minVal))
	end

	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; btn.Text = ""
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); btn.ZIndex = 4; btn.Parent = track
	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
		end
	end)
	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
	local connections = W.getUISConnections()
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			setFromMouse(input.Position.Y)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = false
		end
	end))
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		setFromMouse(UIS:GetMouseLocation().Y)
	end)

	local function bindReadout(box, scale, suffix)
		showValue = function()
			local shown = math.round(current * scale)
			box.Text = (shown == 0 and "0" or string.format("%+d", shown)) .. suffix
		end
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			-- Whatever is not part of a number goes: the suffix, a plus sign, spaces.
			local typed = tonumber((string.gsub(box.Text, "[^%d%.%-]", "")))
			if typed then
				setVal(typed / scale)
			else
				showValue()
			end
		end)
		showValue()
	end

	setVal(defaultVal)
	return getVal, setVal, track, bindReadout
end

-- Rainbow gradient for Hue
local hueGrad = ColorSequence.new({
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.167, Color3.fromHSV(0.167,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.333, Color3.fromHSV(0.333,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromHSV(0.5,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.667, Color3.fromHSV(0.667,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.833, Color3.fromHSV(0.833,1,1)),
	ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)),
})
-- Saturation: white → full color (red as reference)
local satGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1))})
-- Value: white → black
local valGrad = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1,1,1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0,0,0))})

-- The Hue, Saturation and Value sliders, with their get / set functions written into refs.
-- Hue moves in whole degrees, saturation and value in whole percent; under each track the
-- layout's makeReadout(index, xScale) -> TextBox shows the value and takes a typed one.
-- Classic tracks start 26 below the panel top and stop above the labels, readouts and buttons.
function ToolPanels.buildHueSliders(parent, refs, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, makeReadout)
	local sliders = {
		{ name = "Hue", gradient = hueGrad, min = -0.5, max = 0.5, step = 1 / 360, scale = 360, suffix = "\u{00B0}" },
		{ name = "Sat", gradient = satGrad, min = -1, max = 1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
		{ name = "Val", gradient = valGrad, min = 1, max = -1, step = 0.01, scale = 100, suffix = "%" },
	}
	for index, slider in ipairs(sliders) do
		local xScale = (index * 2 - 1) / 6
		local getVal, setVal, _, bindReadout = makeVSlider(parent, xScale, slider.gradient, slider.min, slider.max, 0, trackHeightTrim, trackTop, slider.step)
		refs[slider.name .. "GetVal"] = getVal
		refs[slider.name .. "SetVal"] = setVal
		bindReadout(makeReadout(index, xScale), slider.scale, slider.suffix)
	end
end

--[[
	ToolShell  -  the frame of a floating tool panel: fixed size, resizable from its edges, with a
	header carrying the title, minimize (folds the panel into the HUD tray) and close.
	Loaded by Widgets.luau; receives the shared W table and adds:
	  W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, width, height) -> panel
	      The original shell: a boxed 18 px header inside the panel padding, content placed by
	      absolute offsets from y = 22. Classic builds every tool with it; a panel whose content
	      has no layout for the other modes uses it there too.
	  W.makeToolShell(sg, name, width, height) -> panel, chrome
	      The current mode's shell (Classic: makeToolPanel).
	  W.toolChrome(panel) -> chrome of a panel made by either call:
	      header           frame holding the title and the header buttons
	      title            the title label
	      close, minimize  the two built-in buttons
	      body             parent for content: the panel in the original shell, else a frame below the title bar
	      bodyTop          y inside body where content starts (22 in the original shell, else 0)
	      controlsWidth    width the buttons at the header's right take; grows with addButton
	      addButton(name, text, onClick) -> button placed left of the header buttons already there
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)
local BuildPacer = require(script.Parent.BuildPacer)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

-- Original shell geometry.
local CLASSIC_BODY_TOP = 22
local CLASSIC_CONTROLS = 30
local CLASSIC_BUTTON = 18

return function(W)
	local addCorner, addStroke, addPadding = W.addCorner, W.addStroke, W.addPadding

	-- Panel -> chrome. Weak keys: a destroyed panel drops its entry.
	local chromeOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	function W.toolChrome(panel)
		return chromeOf[panel]
	end

	function W.makeToolPanel(sg, name, w, h)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local panel = Instance.new("Frame"); panel.Name = name.."Panel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg; panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0,w,0,h); panel.ClipsDescendants = true; panel.Active = true; panel.Visible = false; panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner); addStroke(panel); addPadding(panel,5,5,5,5)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		local hd = W.makeBlob("Hd", panel, UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)); hd.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); hd.ZIndex = 10
		local t = Instance.new("TextLabel"); t.BackgroundTransparency = 1; t.Text = name
		t.TextColor3 = T.Gold; t.Font = T.Font; t.TextSize = 10; t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); t.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); t.Parent = hd
		local cb = Instance.new("TextButton"); cb.Name = "Close"; cb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		cb.Text = "X"; cb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; cb.Font = T.Font; cb.TextSize = 9
		cb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); cb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0); cb.ZIndex = 12; cb.Parent = hd
		cb.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)
		-- Minimize folds the panel into the HUD tray (WidgetDeck.collapsePanel); its chip brings it back.
		local mb = Instance.new("TextButton"); mb.Name = "Min"; mb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		mb.Text = "\u{2013}"; mb.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; mb.Font = T.Font; mb.TextSize = 9
		mb.Size = UDim2.new(0,12,1,0); mb.Position = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,0); mb.ZIndex = 12; mb.Parent = hd
		mb.Activated:Connect(function() if W.collapsePanel then W.collapsePanel(panel) end end)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)
		local dg = Instance.new("TextButton"); dg.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dg.Text = ""
		dg.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0); dg.ZIndex = 11; dg.Parent = hd; W.makeDraggable(panel, dg)
		W.makeResizable(panel, math.max(w, 80), 40)

		local chrome = {
			header = hd, title = t, close = cb, minimize = mb,
			body = panel, bodyTop = CLASSIC_BODY_TOP, controlsWidth = CLASSIC_CONTROLS,
		}
		function chrome.addButton(buttonName, text, onClick)
			local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
			button.Name = buttonName
			button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			button.Text = text
			button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			button.Font = T.Font
			button.TextSize = 7
			button.Size = UDim2.new(0, CLASSIC_BUTTON, 1, 0)
			button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(chrome.controlsWidth + CLASSIC_BUTTON), 0, 0)
			button.ZIndex = 12
			button.Parent = hd
			button.Activated:Connect(onClick)
			table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, function()
				button.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold
			end)
			chrome.controlsWidth += CLASSIC_BUTTON
			return button
		end
		chromeOf[panel] = chrome
		return panel
	end

	-- Shell for the modes other than Classic: full-width title bar, content in a body frame under it.
	local function makeModernShell(sg, name, width, height)
		BuildPacer.step()
		local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
		local slot = LAYOUT.IconSlot

		local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
		panel.Name = name .. "Panel"
		panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
		panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
		panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		panel.ClipsDescendants = true
		panel.Active = true
		panel.Visible = false
		panel.Parent = sg
		addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
		addStroke(panel)
		addPadding(panel, pad, pad, pad, pad)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
		W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
		panel:SetAttribute("TrayTitle", name)
